people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,
translations.bsb: Then the band of soldiers, with its commander and the officers of the Jews, arrested Jesus and bound Him.
translations.kjv: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
